mask_checks.scope: every scene of every event in the mirror

feature_rows.name: pre_mean_r
feature_rows.formula: Average red value of the footprint pixels, pre-disaster
feature_rows.why: Baseline roof colour; lets the model judge post values relative to it

feature_rows.name: pre_std_r
feature_rows.formula: Standard deviation of red inside the footprint, pre

feature_rows.name: post_mean_r
feature_rows.why: Debris, ash, mud or exposed timber change roof colour

feature_rows.name: post_mean_g
feature_rows.why: Vegetation or algae on wrecked roofs, mud

feature_rows.name: post_std_r
feature_rows.why: Rubble is patchy, while intact roofs are uniform

feature_rows.name: abs_dmean_r
feature_rows.why: Size of the colour change on the roof

feature_rows.name: dstd_r
feature_rows.formula: post std red − pre std red (signed)
feature_rows.why: Positive = the roof became patchier (debris, holes)

feature_rows.name: gray_absdiff_mean
feature_rows.formula: Average of |post grey − pre grey| over footprint pixels (misalignment-sensitive)
feature_rows.why: Large, local change anywhere on the roof

feature_rows.name: brightness_ratio
feature_rows.formula: post grey mean ÷ max(pre grey mean, 1)
feature_rows.why: Burnt or flooded roofs darken (< 1); exposed concrete or debris can brighten (> 1)

feature_rows.name: gray_std_pre
feature_rows.formula: Std of grey inside the footprint, pre

feature_rows.name: edge_density_pre
feature_rows.formula: Share of footprint pixels marked as edges by Canny (σ = 1.5, run on the footprint + margin)

feature_rows.name: edge_density_post
feature_rows.why: Broken roofs and debris create many short edges

feature_rows.name: edge_density_delta
feature_rows.why: Increase = fragmentation; decrease = a roof replaced by flat ash or water

feature_rows.name: glcm_contrast_pre
feature_rows.formula: Mean of (i − j)² over neighbouring pixel pairs inside the footprint (grey quantised to 32 levels; right and down neighbours)

feature_rows.name: glcm_homogeneity_pre
feature_rows.formula: Mean of 1 / (1 + (i − j)²) over the same pairs (1 = perfectly smooth)

feature_rows.name: ring_dmean
feature_rows.formula: post ring grey mean − pre ring grey mean
feature_rows.why: Surroundings changed: flood water, burn scar, debris field. Separates event-wide change from building change

feature_rows.name: ring_absdiff_mean
feature_rows.formula: Average |post − pre| grey over ring pixels (misalignment-sensitive)
feature_rows.why: Strength of change around the building

feature_rows.name: contrast_change
feature_rows.formula: (post building − post ring) − (pre building − pre ring), grey means
feature_rows.why: Did the building change *relative to* its surroundings? Large values point to damage to the building itself rather than a lighting change

feature_rows.name: area_px
feature_rows.formula: Number of pixels in the footprint blob (exact)
feature_rows.why: Context: building size. Heavy right tail (largest = 648,034 px, a mall complex); scaling matters

feature_rows.name: compactness
feature_rows.formula: 4π × area ÷ perimeter² of the footprint polygon (1 = circle, 0.785 = square, → 0 = thin or irregular)
feature_rows.why: Context: very irregular blobs are often several merged buildings, whose label is less reliable

phase3b_variants.change_only: 17 change / texture-delta / ring / shape features (no absolute pre or post levels)
phase3b_variants.scene_normalised: all 37 features, image features minus their scene median (shape raw)
